snippet.title: Release Date Announcement Trailer - Demon Lord: Just A Block!
snippet.description:
Reborn Demon Lord - reclaim and take revenge！ A turn-based roguelite game with grid-based combat, controlled with four directions. You move, then enemies move - collision means attack. Plan ahead step by step, OR, play fast with dodges and parries, your choice! Every boss features a unique mechanism

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720420/Demon_Lord_Just_a_Block/
X: https://x.com/YuWaveStudio
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/rkvdv66M6h
